import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Bitset {
        long[] data;
        int size;

        public Bitset(int n) {
            size = n;
            data = new long[(n + 63) / 64];
        }

        public void set(int i) {
            data[i / 64] |= (1L << (i % 64));
        }

        public boolean get(int i) {
            return (data[i / 64] & (1L << (i % 64))) != 0;
        }

        public void or(Bitset other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                data[i] |= other.data[i];
            }
        }

        public Bitset copy() {
            Bitset res = new Bitset(size);
            System.arraycopy(data, 0, res.data, 0, data.length);
            return res;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Bitset bitset = (Bitset) o;
            return Arrays.equals(data, 0, (size + 63) / 64, bitset.data, 0, (size + 63) / 64);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Arrays.hashCode(data, 0, (size + 63) / 64);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[][] P = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            }
        }

        Bitset init = new Bitset(128);
        init.set(0);

        Map<Bitset, Integer> stateIndex = new HashMap<>();
        List<Bitset> indexState = new ArrayList<>();
        Queue<Pair<Bitset, Integer>> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();

        stateIndex.put(init, 0);
        indexState.add(init);
        bfsQueue.offer(new Pair<>(init, 0));

        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            Pair<Bitset, Integer> pair = bfsQueue.poll();
            Bitset cur = pair.first;
            int idx = pair.second;
            if (idx != stateIndex.get(cur)) continue;

            Bitset[] derived = new Bitset[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                derived[i] = new Bitset(1 << N);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j) {
                    if ((j >> i & 1) == 0) {
                        int nextIdx = j | (1 << i);
                        if (cur.get(j)) {
                            derived[i].set(nextIdx);
                        }
                        if (derived[i].get(j)) {
                            derived[i].set(nextIdx);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                Bitset nextState = cur.copy();
                for (int bit = 0; bit < N; ++bit) {
                    if ((mask >> bit & 1) == 1) {
                        nextState.or(derived[bit]);
                    }
                }

                if (!stateIndex.containsKey(nextState)) {
                    int newId = stateIndex.size();
                    stateIndex.put(nextState, newId);
                    indexState.add(nextState);
                    bfsQueue.offer(new Pair<>(nextState, newId));
                }
            }
        }

        int totalStates = stateIndex.size();
        int[][] trans = new int[totalStates][1 << N];

        for (int i = 0; i < totalStates; ++i) {
            Bitset cur = indexState.get(i);
            Bitset[] derived = new Bitset[N];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                derived[j] = new Bitset(1 << N);
            }

            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); ++k) {
                    if ((k >> j & 1) == 0) {
                        int nextIdx = k | (1 << j);
                        if (cur.get(k)) {
                            derived[j].set(nextIdx);
                        }
                        if (derived[j].get(k)) {
                            derived[j].set(nextIdx);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                Bitset nextState = cur.copy();
                for (int bit = 0; bit < N; ++bit) {
                    if ((mask >> bit & 1) == 1) {
                        nextState.or(derived[bit]);
                    }
                }
                trans[i][mask] = stateIndex.get(nextState);
            }
        }

        int inv100 = 1, base = 100, exp = MOD - 2;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                inv100 = (int) ((long) inv100 * base % MOD);
            }
            base = (int) ((long) base * base % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }

        long[][] dp = new long[2][totalStates];
        Bitset zeroSet = new Bitset(128);
        zeroSet.set(0);
        dp[0][stateIndex.get(zeroSet)] = 1;
        int curLayer = 0;

        for (int round = 0; round < N; ++round) {
            int[] probs = new int[1 << N];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                probs[mask] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    int coefficient = ((mask >> k & 1) == 1) ? P[round][k] : (100 - P[round][k]);
                    probs[mask] = (int) ((long) probs[mask] * inv100 % MOD);
                    probs[mask] = (int) ((long) probs[mask] * coefficient % MOD);
                }
            }

            Arrays.fill(dp[curLayer ^ 1], 0);

            for (int s = 0; s < totalStates; ++s) {
                if (dp[curLayer][s] == 0) continue;
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                    int nextS = trans[s][mask];
                    dp[curLayer ^ 1][nextS] = (dp[curLayer ^ 1][nextS] + 
                                              dp[curLayer][s] * probs[mask]) % MOD;
                }
            }

            curLayer ^= 1;
        }

        Bitset full = new Bitset(128);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            full.set(i);
        }
        System.out.println(dp[curLayer][stateIndex.get(full)]);
    }

    static class Pair<T, U> {
        T first;
        U second;

        public Pair(T first, U second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
